stories.text: Summer.fi halts vaults after $6 million exploit
stories.summary: DeFi protocol Summer.fi paused its Lazy Summer vaults following a $6 million exploit that caused its SUMR token to drop over 18%.
The SEC ended its investigation into Consensys over Ethereum 2.0, removing a major regulatory overhang for staking.

stories.text: Ripple's Luxembourg license upgraded to fully MiCA-compliant
stories.summary: Ripple's preliminary crypto asset provider license in Luxembourg was upgraded to fully compliant status under MiCA, allowing operations across the EEA.

stories.text: HOOD bets on DeFi, tokenization, and AI trading
stories.summary: Robinhood announced a global expansion push into its own chain, stock tokens, DeFi lending, perpetual futures, and AI-powered trading.

stories.text: BitMine adds $73 million ETH as Strategy dumps Bitcoin
stories.summary: Tom Lee's BitMine accumulated $73 million in Ethereum while Strategy sold off some of its Bitcoin holdings.
